keyboard.device_model: Perixx PERIBOARD-409 U English US candidate
keyboard.feature_source: reviewed housing-edge line segments in the retained 1920x1080 frame
keyboard.target_anchor_source: reviewed visible keycap centers in the retained reference frame

limitations: The housing edges were reviewed in one retained frame and are not measured key centers.
The 46 key centers come from the repository nominal ANSI layout and are not product metrology.
The board homography describes the board plane; the 21 mm-high keyboard produces parallax when mapped through it.
The image-plane keyboard homography is for overlay review only and does not establish board-to-robot or tool geometry.
Any camera, support, board, keyboard, or fiducial movement invalidates this annotation.
